description: Deletes one of the signed-in user's own posts or events, by the id and geoHash the search and create tools return; it disappears from search and its page at once and cannot be restored, so confirm with the user first. Only its author may delete it here, an admin account included.

geoHash.description: geoHash of the post, returned next to its id by the search and create tools.

postId.description: UUID of the post or event.

name: delete_post
title: Delete post
